component.name: ArduTune
component.summary: Set up, diagnose and tune ArduPilot multicopters

description.p: ArduTune helps set up, diagnose and tune ArduPilot multicopters, offline.

ul.li: Setup guide, frame and hardware, motor test and compass calibration
Serial ports, RC channels, GPS status and spoofing checks
AutoTune preparation and an initial tune from the prop size
Filter and PID recommendations from flight logs, flight history per drone
